summary: First-iteration end-to-end testing of AegisShield (FastAPI + React + MongoDB, rule-based). Backend: 21/21 pytest tests passed covering auth (register/login/me/duplicate/invalid), URL scan (safe/phishing/moderate), AI detector (ai/human/insufficient), email detector (phishing/legit GitHub), chat (hello/phishing/password/URL analysis), history (CRUD + auth guard), stats, and /api/widget.js. Frontend: admin login, protected-route redirect when logged out, URL scanner with alarm banner + dismiss + sound toggle + github safe + phishing presets, AI detector (AI/human/insufficient), Email detector (phishing + legit), History filters/search/delete, Overview load, floating ChatWidget open + hello intent + URL analysis reply, and Embed page (snippet with /api/widget.js, copy button, iframe preview). All features in review request verified working.

minor.issue: CORS_ORIGINS="*" combined with allow_credentials=True — browsers reject credentialed cross-origin requests with wildcard. Not an issue in this same-origin preview but will break any cross-origin usage of the console. Set explicit origin list in production.

integration_issues.issue: After admin login the history page briefly showed 0 rows before scans were visible; likely a race between api.get('/history') and auth cookie propagation. Non-blocking; subsequent navigation shows rows.

action_items: (Optional) Replace CORS_ORIGINS="*" with an explicit comma-separated origin list since allow_credentials=True is set.
(Optional) Consider gating /console/history initial fetch until auth context resolves to avoid an empty-flash.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') which is deprecated in modern FastAPI; migrate to lifespan handler.

CORS allow_credentials=True with allow_origins=['*'] is invalid per CORS spec; browsers will refuse credentialed requests cross-origin. Only works today because frontend+backend share the same host under ingress.

login_attempts lockout stores plaintext datetime string and uses $inc even after a successful login attempt reset is deleted — logic is correct but there is no decay/cleanup for stale attempts; consider TTL index.
scan_ai persists only when level != 'insufficient', which is correct — but ensures no DB row for too-short text (good).
Password hash field 'password_hash' is intentionally not returned via User model (good).
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created a few scans under admin user (one deleted during delete-flow test). No manual seed needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_aegis_backend.py is the regression suite — run with `python -m pytest backend/tests/ -v`. All 21 tests passed. Frontend Playwright flow fully covered the review request. Admin login via Bearer token works; cookie is also set. CORS wildcard+credentials is a latent prod bug to flag.
